We need answer JSON only. Need evaluate Well-formed: role and means. Need every story BC-001 to BC-069. Need decide Violation when either stakeholder role or requested functionality cannot be identified from core story text. Need be careful. QUS definition: includes at least role and means (expected functionality). It does not require benefit? Scope individual. We judge only role and means. Need identify role even if "anonymoususer", "authenticateduser", "trainingcoordinator", "attendee", "trainer", "trainee", "administrator", "sponsor", "summit coordinator". Means is the "I want to ..." part. Even if grammar issues, if can identify functionality. Violation only if missing role or means. Need not penalize ambiguous? Operational decision: role or requested functionality cannot be identified. We can likely identify in all? Need check all stories.

Need parse each. BC-001: As a anonymoususer, I want to view a list of sponsors, so... role identified anonymoususer, means view list of sponsors. No violation.

BC-002: anonymoususer view list user profiles. No violation.

BC-003: trainingcoordinator email all trainers at once from website for info and updates. Means: email all trainers. Role present. No violation.

BC-004: attendee, have very clear map where buildings and rooms are. Means? "want to have a very clear map where buildings and rooms are" functionality: provide map/view map? It is a means. No.

BC-005: trainer, edit my training node myself... Means: edit training node. No.
